summary: Writes the default string asc_5CCE18 into the output buffer, then selects a time source: when byte_7CFFF0 bit 0 is set, an index from sub_4D1B50(0) indexes a float table; otherwise the time is read from *(float*)(dword_7C54E0 + 16552). If the selected time is positive it is formatted as " MM:SS.FFF" into the previously written buffer, otherwise the default string remains.

operations.description: Copy the default string asc_5CCE18 into the output buffer a1 with strcpy; the destination pointer is retained for later formatting.
Guard on byte_7CFFF0 bit 0 being set: if set, select the time via the index path, otherwise read it from the object behind dword_7C54E0.
Call sub_4D1B50 with argument 0 to obtain an index value.
If the returned index is 255, return 0 immediately without formatting.
Read the time value from a float-table entry located at 4656 * index relative to the table base shown in the raw source.
Else branch: read the time value from *(float*)(dword_7C54E0 + 16552).
Store the selected time value into a float temporary used for the formatting guard.
Guard on the selected time being greater than 0.0; if not positive the default string already in the buffer is kept.
Call SpatialGridCell with the time value to derive minutes/seconds components into a local.
Format " %.2d:%06.3f" into the retained destination via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the derived components.
